title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 116
description: Ten questions on Psalms 116: love for Yahweh who hears, rescue from the cords of death, the cup of salvation and vows paid in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Why does the psalmist love Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:1 says: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

answers.text: He made him rich in silver and gold
He gave him a kingdom of his own
He won all of his battles for him
He listens to his voice and his cries for mercy

questions.explanation: Psalms 116:3 says the cords of death surrounded him, and the pains of Sheol got hold of him.

questions.text: What did the psalmist ask when he called on Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:4 says he called: "Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul."

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh preserve, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:6 says Yahweh preserves the simple; I was brought low, and he saved me.

questions.text: From what has God delivered the psalmist's eyes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:8 says: you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

questions.text: Where will the psalmist walk before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:9 says: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

answers.text: In the house of the dead
In the land of the living

questions.text: What did the psalmist say in his haste?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:11 says: I said in my haste, "All people are liars."

questions.text: What cup will the psalmist take?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:13 says: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh's name.

questions.text: What is precious in Yahweh's sight?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:15 says: precious in Yahweh's sight is the death of his saints.

questions.text: Where will the psalmist pay his vows to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 116:18-19 says he will pay his vows in the presence of all his people, in the courts of Yahweh's house, in the middle of Jerusalem.

answers.text: In a tent in the land of Egypt
In the courts of Yahweh's house in Jerusalem
On the bank of the Jordan River
On the top of a high mountain
